message.reasoning_content:
We need to read the facts and determine which crimes are directly supported.

Facts: Wang 1, a police officer, from 2007-2014, was head of security team, responsible for anti-prostitution. From 2010 to 2014, he knew a hotel provided prostitution, used his position to protect the hotel, accepted bribes from hotel manager totaling 507,100 yuan. After case, he returned 269,100 yuan.

Also, he abused his power: after receiving bribes, he did not correctly perform duties, gave the hotel manager "通风报信" (leaked information) during anti-prostitution operations, helping the hotel evade, causing continued illegal activities, damaging state reputation, causing social impact.

Thus crimes: (1) Accepting bribes (受贿) by a state functionary. Under Criminal Law article 385? Actually article 385 is "受贿罪". The text says "《中华人民共和国刑法》第三百八十五××、××××之规定". So definitely "受贿罪". (2) Abuse of power (滥用职权罪) - "滥用职权罪" under article 397? Actually article 397 is "滥用职权罪". So "滥用职权罪". Also possibly "徇私舞弊罪"? But the facts mention "向犯罪分子通风报信，滥用职权". So the crime is "滥用职权罪". Also maybe "为他人谋取利益罪"? But that's part of bribery. So answer: 受贿罪;滥用职权罪.

We must output in format: [罪名]受贿罪;滥用职权罪<eoa>

Check if any other crimes: Could be "行贿罪"? No, he is recipient, not giver. Could be "徇私舞弊罪"? That is for judicial personnel. Not police? Actually police are law enforcement, could be "徇私舞弊罪" (abuse of power for personal gain). But the typical charge for police who leak info is "滥用职权罪". So we list those two.

Thus final answer.
